title: The merchant’s wake

branches.condition: Wayfarer completes its commercial contract and Spear intercepts a patrol
branches.consequence: The interception finds its target. At opening Readiness 2+, it achieves combat at total Stability −2. At Readiness 0–1, disable Spear: Stability −1 and no qualifying combat.

branches.condition: No commercial contract completes and Spear intercepts a patrol
branches.consequence: The interception costs Stability −1, but there is no combat and Spear remains intact. Neither council transport substitutes for a completed private contract.

branches.condition: Spear does not intercept a patrol
branches.consequence: No interception effects. Resolve any attack on the anchorage separately.

public_rules: A commercial assignment is not enough: the contract must complete. With no qualifying combat, Readiness falls by 1 once. Consumption and duty breaches are additional.
